subject.title: Discord plugin does not auto-reconnect after 1006 WS close (forces full gateway restart, kills in-flight turns)

question: Is the July 2026 live v2026.6.11 evidence enough to sponsor a Discord reconnect repair now, or should maintainers require another current-main live/transport-harness reproduction before work starts?
rationale: Current source already contains a nominal reconnect path, so an automated repair needs maintainer confidence that the live evidence is sufficient and that the fix should target automatic Discord gateway lifecycle recovery before any new operator reconnect surface.

options.title: Sponsor automatic recovery investigation
options.body: Treat the new live evidence as sufficient and have an owner investigate the Discord gateway lifecycle path with focused tests and live proof before landing a fix.

options.title: Require current-main live proof first
options.body: Keep the item in evidence-gathering until a maintainer or Crabbox run captures the same 1006 close on current main with diagnostic logs around reconnect scheduling and socket creation.

options.title: Prioritize operator reconnect surface
options.body: Defer root-cause repair and first design a channel-scoped reconnect/restart control, accepting that automatic recovery may remain incomplete until a later fix.

recommendation.title: Sponsor automatic recovery investigation
recommendation.body: Treat the new live evidence as sufficient and have an owner investigate the Discord gateway lifecycle path with focused tests and live proof before landing a fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current history signal for the Discord gateway lifecycle, ws transport, and supervision path points to steipete.
